purpose: Request-Now time-parse chain: hallucination-free + lightning fast + aftershock-storm resilient

tier0_deterministic.role: primary for all exact phrases; never-fails floor

tier1_llm_fallback.primary_reason: USER_DIRECTIVE_2026-10-20: free model - zero token depletion during extreme aftershock situations; benchmark 8/8 correct, 1.54s median
tier1_llm_fallback.overflow_reason: free-tier rate limit (~20 req/min) absorbed; ~$0.0001/parse; 8/8 correct, 0.93s median

settings.bias_046_compliance: Free models are never max_tokens-capped (parameter omitted); wallclock guard = 4s fetch timeout on data path, 25s LLM guard

tier1_llm_fallback.validation_gate: invalid JSON / out-of-bounds window -> silent fallback to default 24h window; garbage never reaches the map

referee_async.role: post-fetch verification of merged now-data (dedup, magnitude sanity, staleness); NEVER gates first paint

runtime_fetch.chain: EMSC standing_order WebSocket (warm, reconnect+backoff) + parallel REST fan-out: USGS all_day/all_hour GeoJSON, USGS FDSN, EMSC FDSN, GFZ GEOFON; per-source 4s timeout; progressive render
runtime_fetch.dedup: |dt|<=60s AND <=100km AND |dmag|<=1.0; priority USGS > EMSC > GFZ > IRIS; union ids[]
runtime_fetch.sort: origin_time_ms DESC, tie-break mag DESC then id ASC
runtime_fetch.clock_skew_guard: re-anchor to server time if skew > 120s
